group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Her LinkedIn headshot

turns.text: Turn this into a professional LinkedIn headshot: plain grey studio background, a dark blazer, soft studio light, head and shoulders. Keep her face and her glasses exactly.

tests: The headshot tool (50 credits) against an edit (10): which does it pick, and which keeps the face?

answer_sheet.Who: The woman in the photo, glasses kept.
answer_sheet.Look: Grey studio background, dark blazer, head and shoulders.

must_haves: The face matches the attached photo (the glasses, the light-brown hair, the slight smile).
The background is a plain grey studio background; the hoodie is gone.
The framing is head and shoulders, lit softly.
